content: Zero-downtime secret rotation core pattern: sign/verify with old AND new key simultaneously for an overlap window sized to the artifact's max lifetime (e.g., webhook consumers' update lag, or unsubscribe-link realistic click window), then retire the old key. Two-credential/dual-secret rotation (two DB users, two API keys) is a general variant of the same idea. Config should support hot-reload of key sets without process restart. Applies directly to unsubscribe-link HMAC secrets: primary secret always signs new links; an ordered list of previous secrets is tried during verification until one succeeds or the list is exhausted.
